summary: John's 9th-great-grandmother, daughter of Southold founder William Wells.
bio: Born 1666 to William Wells and his second wife Mary (surname unknown). The tree names her mother 'Mary Maria YOUNGS 1619–1709', a tradition rejected by Hayes (1878) and Youngs (1907). Her sons James and Joshua were full brothers, so the Wells descent survives the tree's James/Joshua confusion — the deep-dive report notes this makes William Wells the best Society of Colonial Wars route.
